clauses.clause: ≥ 2 escape paths ≥ 2.5 m wide from each enclosure; marker points at the APC (fixed).
clauses.note: Fresh original native1.25m-radius navigation proof passes separate north/south interior paths,6m gate crossings and onward APC paths for all5enclosures at bothqualities. A full-width slab at either gate blocks that explicit crossing. Current actual L7-result campaigns (low0/high9humans) restored normally intoL8. Actual physical WASD walks reach all46goals eachquality, including10exit crossings perquality and finalAPC ring; no teleports, actor writes, skips or changed caps/timing. Sampled crossing lateral deviation<=0.2634m low/0.3786m high from gate centerline. Each row arrives from interior via the stated north and south openings. Every sampled exit anchor equals initial fixedAPC boarding ring, marker absent duringcalm thenexit. All44photos personally inspected at original size atzoom0.5/1.5: open paved fence passages, courier/corgi outside gates, marker atplainAPC; redbar crowds remain active and aggregate over thelong protected walk. Exact rawhashes verified beforedeletion. Courier protection qualifies traversal geometry, not mortal balance. No game/target/performance changes.
